answer: Sybil resistance here rests on a non-transferable work budget plus a bond that only unlocks after independent review. Every new identity must pay an entry stake and complete tasks signed by a seed it cannot predict, so a canyon of cloned wallets cannot share one answer. Reputation from a wharf of witnesses converts into a gated terrace of voting power, and forfeiting the bond on any failed audit makes mass identity creation cost real money per head.
